stresses: UNIT-DISAMBIGUATION crux: three leakage references in one breath -- 210 CFM25 (duct), 3600 CFM50 (blower door), ~8 ACH50 (NO field) -- must land on ductLeakageCfm25 and blowerDoorCfm50 respectively and NOT cross-contaminate. HAZARD 1 heat-pump on shared ducts -> central_heat_pump on both heating and cooling axes, fuel electricity. WRONG-FIELD trap: the identical neighbor's OIL BOILER is in the audio and must not populate this all-electric house. HPWH -> heat_pump_water_heater; "six or seven years" -> 6-10.

notes.ductLeakageCfm25: 210, explicitly the duct-blaster-at-25-Pa number. Must NOT receive the 3600 (that's CFM50) or the 8 (ACH50). The auditor narrates the disambiguation on purpose.
notes.blowerDoorCfm50: 3600, explicitly the whole-house blower door at 50 Pa. The ~8 ACH50 has NO field in this schema and must be dropped, not filed here.
notes.heatingFuel: electricity, NOT fuel_oil. The neighbor's oil boiler is a WRONG-FIELD distractor the auditor explicitly excludes ("nothing to do with this house, ignore that"). heatingEquipmentType must be central_heat_pump, never boiler.
notes.coolingEquipmentType: central_heat_pump: the same shared-duct heat pump provides cooling, so it fills the cooling axis too (the schema comment notes central_heat_pump is shared between heating and cooling). The same span justifies both.
notes._general: This house has no combustion appliances (all electric), so combustionVentType and every safety test are null. Distractors: "minus"-nothing here, but the ACH50 (8) is the key no-field number.
